description: This file is a shell script used for managing system LEDs related to power and fault status, notably in the context of a system initialization or failure scenarios. It defines functions to identify specific LED indicators and change their states based on different system stages.

methods.name: get_status_led
methods.description: Finds the power status LED by searching in /sys/class/leds/ for an entry ending with :power and returns its basename.
methods.returns: Name of the power status LED or nothing if not found.

methods.name: get_failsafe_led
methods.description: Finds the fault status LED by searching in /sys/class/leds/ for an entry ending with :fault and returns its basename.
methods.returns: Name of the fault status LED or nothing if not found.

methods.name: set_state
methods.description: Sets the LED states based on the argument passed, such as 'preinit', 'failsafe', 'preinit_regular', 'upgrade', and 'done'. It calls appropriate LED control functions accordingly.
